test_title: PYST 40: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹4000 as a sum borrowed at 4% per year rate of interest for 4 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4000

Rate of interest (R) = 4% per year

Time (T) = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest = (₹4000 × 4 × 4) / 100

⇒ SI = (4000 × 16) / 100

⇒ SI = 640

**The simple interest is ₹640.**
